repeats.pattern: Every shot's caption carries the clock's date and one figure (a price, a count, a share, a range). The caption is the counter; nothing counts elsewhere.
Every city incident holds the 'before' state for 2 s on the sheet before anything moves (T1 shot 4, T6 shot 1, T8 shot 1).

Every route scene pans the globe to keep the leading stop centred at a constant 1.2 s per leg; distance never sets duration. Undated legs are dashed and the readout shows a span. The undated road (T4) steps by place with the clock held and says so.
Every world scene keeps context when it cuts to a region: inset locator, full route at a quarter (T2 shot 5).
Every scene ends on an object on the stage: the map hands off to the proof (the cat, the cover, Red Fuji and the Wave, the Kyoto sheet, the empty catfish margin, the Sharaku, the Shower).
Argued stations are offered after the evidence shot, never before (b3-4 after the price, b5-7 after the count and the bubble, b7-6 after the counts).
Guesses are the existing nine or none: five scenes carry one (b5-2, b7-1g, b3-2g, b2-4, I4's map tap); three carry none because the content supports none (T4, T7, T8). No timers, no scores.

One primary and at most three others; close pairs (Sakai-chō/Fukiya-chō, Nihonbashi/Shinagawa, Berlin/Amsterdam, Port Said/Suez, Kanagawa/Yokohama, Shin-Ōhashi/Atake, Asakusa/Shin-Yoshiwara/Saruwaka-chō) are labelled one at a time as their leg draws or share one leader.

Every scene has an honesty line: approximate blots, dashed undated legs, stand-ins (the early-1830s sheet for the 1829 fan; the 1802 shop for 1783; the 1859 map for 1657 and 1750), 'linked, not shown', the argued count. The framework needs one caption-footer slot for it.

Micro-elements come from a fixed set of fourteen own-drawn CC0 glyphs (ship, junk, steamer, crate, pavilion, shop, book, fan, pigment, coin, soba bowl, flame, seals: one cut and three stamped, bubble), each drawn only where a line demands it. No flag appeared because no line demanded one.
The quarter is a labelled district and a mark that moves, with the content note once and no interior; punishments are named with their verbs and no glyph; death tolls are ranges on a card.
Runs are capped at twelve ticks: afterlife (15) splits into Paris and America; the Tōkaidō's 55 stations become nine print stations. Every scene has 3–7 shots and at most nine ticks.
Reduced motion is the same scene: every flight a cut, every draw a fade, every flicker a static mark; captions and end states identical.
